title: Turkish Kebab Wraps
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make Turkish-inspired dish, perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
In a large bowl, combine flour and Turkish seasoning blend.
Gradually add warm water to the flour mixture and knead for 5 minutes.
Divide dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each one into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a thin circle.
Brush each circle with a little water.
Place a tablespoon of zesty hummus and silky tahini in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press edges together to seal.
Cook the wraps in the preheated pan for 2-3 minutes on each side.
